case_name: Ashwin Alias Tina v. Kushalpal Singh
facts_of_case: The petitioner is a lady with one minor child and seeks transfer of two cases from Family Court, Kota to District Court, Baran.

legal_principles.principle: In cases where a lady-petitioner has a minor child, it would be difficult for her to attend the court.
legal_principles.held: looking to the fact that the petitioner is a woman, having a minor child, the Apex Court held that it would be difficult for her to attend the Court at Palamu and allowed the transfer application.
cited_cases: Arti Rani Alias Pinki Devi and Another Vs. Dharmendra Kumar Gupta, (2008) 9 Supreme Court Cases 353

outcome.final_order: Both the transfer petitions are allowed. Divorce Petition No. 549/2009 alongwith Misc. Application No. 122/2010 under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act and another Application No. 49/2009 filed under the provisions of Guardian and Wards Act pending in the Family Court, Kota may be transferred to the Court of District Judge, Baran.
